source_correction_notes: Fraisse 1954 Sec. 10.1 (p. 388) asserts every arithmetic type satisfies condition C; thm:p03-w03-p03-014-arithmetic-types part 2 proves a counterexample under the Sec. 4.7 definition of C.
Fraisse 1954 Sec. 7.3 (p. 382): the printed class with exactly one positive element is not closed under restriction; the repaired class is 'at most one'.
Rado 1964 Sec. 4.2 (p. 337): the remark that m may be assumed initial fails as a reduction by cardinality (thm:p03-rado64-order-type-boundary); Theorem 6 is unaffected.
